dict.string: Lid Awake shows your Mac's camera on your phone, only while you watch it there (with Face ID or fingerprint each time).
Lid Awake lets you hear your Mac's microphone on your phone, only while you watch the camera there.
Lid Awake reads the name of the Wi-Fi network your Mac is on, to show it on your phone. It doesn't use or share your location.
